name: Enhanced movement (Going Commando)
author: kmomoney
description: Ratchet moves as in Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando: his speed follows how far the stick is pushed, he gets going and stops quicker and turns as in the second game, with its turnaround and no skid when you let go; more control in the air; Going Commando's strafe on L2 or R2, with its side and back flips and hip twist; Going Commando's wrench timing; a choice of camera turn speed: the first game's or Going Commando's fastest; and Clank's own sections played with Going Commando's Clank or past it. Jump heights and wrench and punch damage stay the first game's, so every level plays as built.

conflicts.reason: both strafe on L2 and R2 and take the same hook points
the same mod under its old name: remove it

settings.name: Going Commando running
settings.description: Speed follows how far the stick is pushed, Ratchet gets going and stops quicker, turns and turns around as in Going Commando, and stops without a skid when you let go.

settings.name: Going Commando air control
settings.description: More control of Ratchet in the air, as in Going Commando (quicker in jumps, much more in the double jump). Jump heights stay the first game's.

settings.name: Strafe button
settings.description: Hold it to strafe as in Going Commando: Ratchet faces where the camera looks and the left stick moves him. L1 still looks and R1 still crouches; with one button only, the other stays the game's.

settings.name: Strafe flips
settings.description: Strafing, X with the stick pushed fully left, right or back flips that way.

settings.name: Hip twist
settings.description: Strafing, Ratchet's hips turn toward where he goes while his upper body keeps facing ahead.

settings.name: Going Commando wrench
settings.description: The wrench handles as in Going Commando: Square is remembered a little longer, the lock-on turn is quicker, you can run or jump out of a swing sooner and move on while a thrown wrench flies, and the slam keeps its drive from high up. Damage stays the first game's.

settings.name: Camera rotation
settings.description: How fast the right stick turns the camera behind Ratchet. Going Commando's is its fastest camera, 132 degrees a second whatever the game's own camera speed (the first game turns 78 by default, 96 at its fastest). First person stays the game's.

settings.name: Clank
settings.description: How Clank handles when he goes on alone. Going Commando: he gets going and stops quicker, turns and turns around as in the second game, leaves the ground sooner in a jump and turns to a target quicker. Enhanced (the default): Going Commando's Clank, a little faster, with more control in his jump, Square remembered longer and a quicker way out of a punch. Jump heights and punch damage stay the first game's; Giant Clank stays the game's.

settings.name: Trace
settings.description: For bug reports: a line in the game's log each tick with what the mod decided and every input it used.
